# v0.8.0 — Incremental reasoning

## Highlights

- **Core:** axiom dirty tracking, `remove_axiom`, `ReasonerSession` on `Reasoner`
- **EL:** `ElSession` + partition overdelete-rederive on `CompletionGraph`
- **RL/RDFS:** `ReasonableSession` over reasonable incremental `reason()`
- **`ontologos-watch`:** file-watch library for Ontocode (workspace-only)
- **CLI / Python:** `--incremental` / `incremental=True`

## Upgrade

Bump all `ontologos-*` crates to **0.8.0** together. Default remains batch (`incremental: false`).

See [docs/migration/v0.7.x-to-v0.8.0.md](../../docs/migration/v0.7.x-to-v0.8.0.md) and [docs/guides/incremental-reasoning.md](../../docs/guides/incremental-reasoning.md).
